components.name: Price Tag
components.description: Yellow ink block with navy kilo price and a pink 4px misregistration offset; pinned top-right of every card.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; background: var(--yellow, #f5c330); color: var(--on-yellow, #1f2f8f); padding: 6px 10px 7px; text-align: right; line-height: 1; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--pink, #e43f7e); } .ds-tag strong { display: block; font: 900 1.85rem/0.95 var(--display, 'Fira XC', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.005em; } .ds-tag span { display: block; font: 800 0.72rem/1 var(--display, 'Fira XC', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; margin-top: 3px; }

components.name: Price Scale
components.description: Three-ink band with a pink marker at this coffee's €/kg percentile among coffees in stock.
components.css: .ds-scale { margin: 0; display: grid; gap: 6px; width: 260px; } .ds-scale-track { position: relative; height: 18px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--blue, #2140b8) 0 33.33%, var(--yellow, #f5c330) 33.33% 66.66%, var(--pink, #e43f7e) 66.66% 100%) 0 50% / 100% 6px no-repeat; } .ds-scale-mark { position: absolute; top: 0; left: var(--pos, 50%); width: 18px; height: 18px; margin-left: -9px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--pink, #e43f7e); border: 2.5px solid var(--blue, #2140b8); } .ds-scale figcaption { font: 0.82rem/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink-2, #46508f); } .ds-scale b { color: var(--ink, #1f2f8f); }

components.name: Coffee Card
components.description: Fresh-sheet tile in a 1.5px pink keyline, square corners, 14px padding.

components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--sheet, #f8f1e2); border: 1.5px solid var(--pink, #e43f7e); padding: 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; width: 280px; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; font: 800 1.4rem/1.02 var(--display, 'Fira XC', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--blue, #2140b8); } .ds-card h3 a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-card h3 a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--pink, #e43f7e); } .ds-card h3 a:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--pink, #e43f7e); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-sub { margin: 0; font: 0.88rem/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink-2, #46508f); } .ds-opts { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 10px 0 0; border-top: 1.5px solid var(--pink, #e43f7e); display: flex; gap: 4px 16px; font: 0.88rem system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink-2, #46508f); } .ds-opts b { color: var(--blue, #2140b8); font: 800 1rem/1 var(--display, 'Fira XC', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); margin-right: 3px; }

components.name: Chips
components.description: Square outlined caps chips; taste chips lead with an ink shape, state chips are filled washes.
components.html: Fruity / floralChocolate / nutty12% since last check5% since last checkSold out
components.css: .ds-chips { margin: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: 1.5px solid var(--blue, #2140b8); padding: 2px 8px; font: 700 0.85rem/1.3 var(--display, 'Fira XC', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; color: var(--blue, #2140b8); } .ds-dot { width: 11px; height: 11px; } .ds-fruity { background: var(--pink, #e43f7e); border-radius: 50%; } .ds-choc { background: var(--blue, #2140b8); clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-drop { background: var(--teal-soft, #d3eee6); border-color: transparent; color: var(--teal, #0f6e60); } .ds-rise { background: var(--pink-soft, #fbd6e4); border-color: transparent; color: var(--pink-ink, #b8205a); } .ds-sold { background: var(--blue, #2140b8); border-color: transparent; color: var(--paper, #f2e8d3); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Square cream field with a 1.5px blue stroke, pink-ink caps label, pink focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; width: 300px; } .ds-field > span { font: 700 0.85rem/1 var(--display, 'Fira XC', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--pink-ink, #b8205a); } .ds-field input { min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 12px; border: 1.5px solid var(--blue, #2140b8); border-radius: 0; background: var(--field, #fffaf0); color: #1f2f8f; font: 1rem system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #5a6399; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--pink, #e43f7e); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled button (empty-state reset): pink-ink block with a 4px blue offset that it presses into.
components.css: .ds-btn { font: 800 1.1rem/1 var(--display, 'Fira XC', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 12px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: var(--pink-ink, #b8205a); color: var(--on-pink, #fff); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--blue, #2140b8); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--pink, #e43f7e); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--blue, #2140b8); }

components.css: .ds-menu { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0 0 22px; width: 200px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--pink, #e43f7e); } .ds-menu a { display: block; padding: 6px 0; color: var(--blue, #2140b8); text-decoration: none; font: 700 1.2rem/1.15 var(--display, 'Fira XC', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; } .ds-menu a:hover, .ds-menu a.ds-active { color: var(--pink-ink, #b8205a); } .ds-menu a.ds-active::before { content: ''; display: inline-block; width: 9px; height: 9px; margin: 0 8px 2px 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--pink, #e43f7e); vertical-align: middle; } .ds-menu a:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--pink, #e43f7e); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-ledger { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-ledger li { background: var(--sheet, #f8f1e2); border: 2px solid var(--blue, #2140b8); padding: 8px 14px 10px; font: 700 0.85rem/1.1 var(--display, 'Fira XC', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--ink-2, #46508f); } .ds-ledger b { display: block; font: 900 1.9rem/1 var(--display, 'Fira XC', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); color: var(--blue, #2140b8); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: 0; }

components.name: Display Title
components.description: Giant condensed caps in blue with a 3px pink misregistration plate, multiplied onto paper.
components.css: .ds-h1 { margin: 0; max-width: 640px; font: 900 4rem/0.9 var(--display, 'Fira XC', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -0.005em; color: var(--blue, #2140b8); text-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--pink, #e43f7e); text-wrap: balance; mix-blend-mode: var(--type-blend, multiply); }

narrative.overview:
The site is a risograph print shop's wall with the Greek coffee market pinned up on it. Everything is printed in three inks (fluorescent pink, riso blue, sunflower yellow) on warm cream paper, overprinted with multiply blending so where two inks cross a third colour appears, and a fixed grain sheet lies over the whole print. Headings are giant black-weight condensed caps in blue with a pink plate printed a few pixels out of register. The kilo price is the loudest ink on every sheet: a yellow block with blue numerals.

Density is a working market list, not a showroom. A printed left rail carries the wordmark, a geometric mark, the menu and a shape legend; the page to the right opens with a poster header (overprinting circles, triangles and blocks behind the title) and then goes straight to filters and a tight card grid. Corners are square everywhere; rules are 1.5-2px ink lines. Depth only ever comes from ink: overprint, misregistration offset, grain. In dark mode the same press runs on navy paper, the inks lighten and blend by screen instead of multiply.
keyCharacteristics: Cream paper (`paper`) under a fixed fractal-noise grain at 16% opacity (10% in dark).
Three inks only, plus a teal signal ink reserved for "fresh" and "price dropped".
Fira Sans Extra Condensed, uppercase, 700-900, for every heading, label, number and nav item; the system UI face for reading text.
Pink misregistration (3px text-shadow on display type, 3-4px offset on the price tag) as the signature print artefact.
Overprinting flat geometric shapes (circle, triangle, square/block) with `mix-blend-mode: multiply` (screen in dark).
Square corners, 1.5-2px ink rules, no soft shadows, no gradients except the three-band price scale.

rules.name: The Three Inks Rule
rules.body: Decorative colour is pink, blue and yellow and nothing else. Teal is a signal, never a decoration; a fourth decorative hue breaks the press.

rules.name: The Overprint Rule
rules.body: Ink shapes that overlap blend with `multiply` on paper and `screen` on navy (`--blend`). The crossing colour is the point; never stack opaque shapes.

rules.name: The Yellow Carries Blue Rule
rules.body: Yellow is always printed with blue (`on-yellow`) on top. White or pink on yellow is never legible enough.

rules.name: The Misregistration Rule
rules.body: Only the display title gets the pink text plate (3px 3px 0). Smaller headings print in one ink; a doubled plate at card size turns to mush.

rules.name: The Condensed Caps Rule
rules.body: Anything that is a heading, number, label or button is Fira XC in uppercase at 700 or heavier. Sentences are never set in it.

rules.name: The Rail Rule
rules.body: Navigation lives in the left rail on desktop and becomes a top strip on phones; there is no separate header bar.

rules.name: The Second Plate Rule
rules.body: An offset is a second ink, never grey or black, never blurred, and never more than 4px.

dos: **Do** print every decorative mark in pink, blue or yellow, and let overlaps blend (`--blend`: multiply on paper, screen on navy).
**Do** keep the kilo price in the yellow tag with blue numerals and the pink 4px offset, and keep the three-ink scale under it.
**Do** set headings, numbers, labels, nav and buttons in Fira XC uppercase at 700-900; set sentences in the system face.
**Do** keep corners square and draw edges as 1.5-2px ink keylines.
**Do** use pink ink (`pink-ink`), not fluorescent pink, for any pink text.
**Do** code taste by shape and ink together (pink circle, blue triangle, yellow square).
**Do** keep form fields as cream paper with navy text in both schemes, at least 44px tall.
donts: **Don't** add soft, blurred, grey or black shadows; the only offset is a second ink of up to 4px.
**Don't** round corners on cards, tags, chips, inputs or buttons.
**Don't** use teal decoratively; it means fresh data or a price drop.
**Don't** put the pink misregistration plate on anything smaller than the page title.
**Don't** print white or pink text on yellow.
**Don't** add gradients beyond the three-band price scale.
